props.description: Feed gas high pressure protection of inlet KO drum
props.functional_description: On feed gas high-high pressure, close XV-1001 and open BDV-1001 to protect V-1002
props.hazard: Overpressure of inlet KO drum V-1002; loss of containment
props.bypass_conditions: Bypass permitted for testing only, one channel at a time, with PAH-1005 confirmed active; max 8 h

props.description: Inlet KO drum high level - liquid carry-over protection

props.hazard: Liquid carry-over to compressor; equipment damage
props.bypass_conditions: Bypass permitted with LAH-1006 confirmed active and operator on watch; max 4 h

props.description: Feed gas low pressure - reverse flow protection

props.hazard: Reverse flow from V-1002 to battery limit
props.bypass_conditions: No bypass without a temporary low-pressure alarm configured; max 2 h

props.conditions: Valid while PT-1005 / PIC-1005 are in service and PV-1005 is not isolated. Confirm alarm is not shelved or suppressed before relying on it.
props.rationale: SIF-100-01 trips at 68 barg on PT-1001A/B/C (SIS, L-101). PT-1005 is a BPCS pressure transmitter on L-102 immediately downstream of V-1002, the protected vessel, two process hops from the SIS sensors: same pressure system, separate transmitter, separate system. Its PAH at 60 barg (Medium) annunciates 8 barg below the trip point, giving operations time to act. Independent of any single bypassed SIS element. Recommend raising PAH-1005 priority to High for the duration of a bypass.

props.conditions: Only while PT-1001A itself is in service. NOT a compensating measure when PT-1001A is the bypassed element or when the bypass is applied at the input of the logic solver for channel A.
props.rationale: PAH-1001 at 62 barg (High) is derived from PT-1001A, one of the SIF's own 2oo3 initiators (register X11). It is a useful pre-alarm when the bypass is on PT-1001B, PT-1001C, XV-1001 or BDV-1001, because the sensor keeps working; it shares a failure mode with the SIF and is therefore ranked second, behind the independent BPCS measurement.

props.conditions: Valid while LT-1006 / LIC-1006 are in service and LV-1006 is available. Confirm alarm is not shelved.
props.rationale: SIF-100-02 trips at 1750 mm (87.5 % of the 0-2000 mm span) on LT-1002A/B (SIS, GWR, on V-1002). LT-1006 is the BPCS DP level transmitter on the same vessel, on the LIC-1006 control loop, independent of the SIS transmitters. Its LAH at 75 % (High) annunciates 12.5 % of span before the trip. LIC-1006 also acts on LV-1006 to bring level down, so the operator has both an alarm and a control response. LG-1002 (magnetic gauge, local) is a field cross-check only, not a compensating measure in its own right.
